title: Page 152
transc:
No 6 1.30 PM
Cobb Chicago Ill  Wash. Aug 11 1864
Washn Aug 11th 1 30 PM
for Maj Gen Jno Pope Mil -
waukee ---- Gen Grant has ordered
the 1st Regt U S Vols
over a thousand strong composed of
refugees and deserters from the Rebel
States to your Dept for duty
---- The detachment of the 1st
Conn Cavalry can be assigned for
duty with this Reg't and be
so mustered and paid ---- Genl
Grant directs that all the troops
that can possibly be spared from
your Dept be sent to Genl
Shermans Army in Ga in anticipation
of the arrival of this Regt
sig H W Halleck Chf Staff
